# Step - set_visualizer

`set_visualizer` · category: [Running and showing results](../../traversal/step_reference.md#running-and-showing-results)

Sets how results of g are displayed in this session (a V token such as V.Table or V.Json).

## Forms

```text
set_visualizer(arg1: VisualizeFormat)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
{ g.set_visualizer(V.Json); g.v(1).values("name").to_list() }   // ["marko"]
```

## See also

- [Displaying Results](../../users_guide/displaying_results.md)
